6.0Notes & Assumptions

For preliminary design and educational use. Distribution factors are computed by the approximate method of AASHTO LRFD Article 4.6.2.2. The empirical S-based equations use the average beam spacing; the rigid cross-section method uses the actual (variable) beam positions. Results must be verified against the governing edition of the AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications and confirmed by a licensed professional engineer of record.
